Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and a small beauty mark near her lips. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a marble counter in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic open box of chocolates with glossy dark truffles each as big as a boulder, giant gold foil wrappers crinkled like sculptures, a giant raspberry and a giant red ribbon, a softly blurred cozy kitchen far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on a giant glossy truffle with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous chocolate truffles, foil wrappers and raspberry around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
